entries.descriptionOriginal: WARM-UP LAB — aim training & warm-up An original aim training map with real CS2 bots, timed drills and saved records. Walk into a glowing portal in the hub to enter a room, shoot a button to change a setting, and beat your best scores. Bots never shoot back and you never take damage: just aim. THE ROOMS BOT ARENA 3 lanes: 300, 900 and 1800 units. 1 to 10 bots, static, strafing (ADAD) or strafing + crouching, at 3 speeds. Every 30 kills is a timed run with a rank: S (under 25 s), A, B or C. Live headshot % and accuracy. Options: headshot only, bot helmet, bot glow. 5 visual themes (desert, old town, plaster, ruins, concrete). SPRAY LAB Spray the white wall from the 300, 600 or 1000 line: the first 10 bullets are scored (average spread radius). Spray guide: a green dot moves on the wall and shows where to aim for the next bullet. Recoil patterns measured in game for the AK-47, M4A4, M4A1-S, Galil and FAMAS. CLEAR WALL removes every bullet hole. TRANSFER: 5 waves of 3-4 bots (static, then strafing). Clear each group in one magazine. STRAFE LANE Counter-strafe: every shot says STOPPED or MOVING, with your best streak. Peek drill: wait behind the wall, strafe out, stop, shoot. The bot only stays a moment. Average reaction time. REACTION ROOM Reaction: 10 targets, average and best time. Gridshot: 30 seconds, 3 targets at once. Don't shoot: hit the orange targets, never the red ones (-3 points). PREFIRE COURSES 5 original timed courses: Desert Alley, Old Town, Bazaar, Temple Ruins, Warehouse. Bots appear at the angles as you move forward. Clear every angle, then reach the blue line. 3 difficulties: how many positions a bot can take, how long it stays visible, double peeks. FLICK RANGE Rest your crosshair on the dot, a bot appears, flick to it: only the first bullet counts. Close, mid or long range; micro, wide or mixed angles; AK-47, Desert Eagle, AWP or Scout. 30 targets per series, with a rank, your first-shot hit %, and whether you overshoot or stop short on each side. RUSH You are T behind the boxes. 3 to 5 expert bots (4 by default) rush you from the left, the middle, the right, or split up. Real bots that move, aim and shoot. They get the CT version of your weapon (AK-47 → M4A4, USP-S → Glock…). Kill them all to win the round. Best time and win streak saved per number of bots. GUIDED ROUTINE QUICK (about 5 min) or FULL (about 12 min): the map takes you through the rooms step by step, with a goal per step and a summary at the end. CONTROLS Shoot a wall button to use it. Green = on, grey = off. Double-tap SHIFT (or type !menu) to open the settings menu. Click CLOSE or double-tap SHIFT again to close it. Ping (mouse 3 by default) restarts the current exercise. Type !hub to come back to the hub, !help for the in-game help. SETTINGS Weapon: AK-47, M4A4, M4A1-S, AWP, Galil, FAMAS, Desert Eagle, USP-S, Glock, SSG 08 (Scout). Infinite ammo: the magazine stays full, no reload (the transfer drill keeps a real magazine). Bots: number, movement, speed, helmet, glow. Headshot only. Difficulty. Arena theme. Spray guide. Map sounds on/off. Your settings and best scores are saved between sessions. The records board in the hub shows them all. CHAT COMMANDS Rooms: !hub !arena !spray !transfer !strafe !peek !reaction !gridshot !dontshoot !prefire !flick !rush Settings: !weapon ak47 · !ammo · !guide · !bots 5 · !move static|strafe|crouch · !speed slow|normal|fast · !helmet · !hs · !glow · !sound · !diff easy|normal|hard · !theme dust|inferno|mirage|ancient|cache Other: !reset · !routine quick|full|stop · !records · !reset_records · !menu · !help · !debug HOW TO PLAY Subscribe, then Play → Workshop Maps → Warm-up Lab. Works in Casual, Competitive and Custom; offline, with bots. Built for solo practice: the exercises follow the first human player. Original map, built from scratch with the CS2 Workshop Tools. Feedback and ideas are welcome in the comments.

entries.descriptionOriginal: Version Alpha 0.1 Custom aim trainer for Counter-Strike 2. Features Custom UI (Tab Menu): Play, Shooting Range, Stats, Achievements, Customize, Settings. Play Page: Grid of exercise cards with preview, personal records, and level status. Shooting Range: Real bots and targets with options for bot count, movement, distance, health, orientation, weapon, and ammo. Daily Warmup: Playlist of 5 random modes (60s each) with Reroll and Start options. Focus Index & Ranks: Rating system (0 to 1000) across 7 tiers (Recruit, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Elite) with badges. Per-Exercise Feedback: High scores, level progression, rating out of 100, and shot heatmap. Stats Hub: Radar overview, evolution graph, detailed table, game history, and training calendar. Customization: Weapons, knives, target colors, room themes, and interface themes. Audio Controls: Music and sound effects volume in Settings. Local Saves: All progression and settings saved locally on your computer. Exercises Grid (Precision): 3 spheres on a fixed grid — a new one spawns after every hit. Tracking (Tracking): Keep crosshair on the moving sphere. Flick (Speed): One small sphere popping up far from the previous position. Silhouettes (Realism): Humanoid targets — headshots award 150 points. Micro-flick (Precision): Tiny spheres near the center for micro-adjustments. Reflexes (Reaction): Shoot as soon as the panel turns green. Strafe (Realism): Humanoid silhouettes strafing left and right. Endurance (Precision): Grid exercise with no timer — 3 misses and it ends. Peek (Reaction): Hold the angle — a silhouette briefly peeks out of cover. Spray Control (Precision): AK-47 — 10 bursts of at least 8 bullets inside the circle. Counter-strafe (Precision): Move, counter-strafe, and shoot while stopped. Vertical Tracking (Tracking): Sphere moves vertically up and down. In development: Pre-aim Corridor, Retake, Site Defense, 1v1 Duels. How to play Subscribe to the map on the Workshop. Launch from the Workshop maps list in CS2 (Practice / Offline). Press Tab to open the menu. Known issues (Alpha) Bullet decals stay visible — type r_decals 0 in the developer console to hide them. Some knife models are not yet verified in-game. Some music fade settings are not fully checked. Early Alpha version: balance, ratings, and layout subject to change. Feedback Leave a comment below for bugs or suggestions. A thumbs up helps support development.

entries.descriptionOriginal: aim_bubbles — underwater aim trainer Pop soap bubbles on a coral reef under a glass dome, with the moon and the stars of a night sky above. Four training modes, 30/60/90-second sessions, a combo multiplier and personal records, all in an animated menu and HUD (English and Turkish). Modes • Gridshot: three bubbles on a grid (four on hard). Every pop opens a new spot. • Flick: one small bubble at a time, far from the last one. Faster pops score more. • Tracking: no gun, only your crosshair. Keep it on the gliding bubble: points flow every second on target, and the bubble pops once you hold it long enough. • Reflex: wait for the bubble to appear, then react. Shooting early costs points. Options: difficulty (easy/normal/hard), weapon (AK-47, M4A4, M4A1-S, AWP, Desert Eagle, USP-S, Glock-18), duration (30/60/90 s), bubble size and speed, sound level (on/low/off) and language. Records count only the default size and speed. Scoring: the multiplier runs from x1 to x3. • Gridshot: every 5 pops in a row add x0.5. A miss resets it. • Flick, Tracking and Reflex: a flow meter. Fast pops, or keeping your crosshair on target, fill it. Misses, time off target and time itself drain it, so a single miss costs one step, not the whole multiplier. Flick and Reflex misses cost 25 points. Your final score is your points times an accuracy factor, so spraying does not pay. Results: a grade (S/A/B/C), accuracy, pops, best combo, misses, reaction time and a chart of your last five sessions with your previous best. The top 10 per mode, difficulty, weapon and duration is saved on the server, so friends on the same server compete on the same table. Playing with friends: there is one cabin. Other players wait in line on the viewing deck. The next one gets the cabin when the current player's results appear, or when that player idles in the menu. Controls: pick your options in the menu and press DIVE IN. During a session, R restarts and E goes back to the menu. Chat commands: !start flick hard awp and !stop. Play with your usual sensitivity.
